title: Sensor Battery Lifecycle
scenario: Find the average lifespan (days between installation and first failure/alert) of different sensor models.
tableSchema: sensor_registry (sensor_id INT, model_name VARCHAR, installation_date DATE), climate_alerts (sensor_id INT, alert_time TIMESTAMP)
hint: Join registry with first alert timestamp, compute difference.
correctQuery: SELECT model_name, AVG(first_alert - installation_date) FROM (SELECT r.model_name, r.installation_date, MIN(a.alert_time::DATE) as first_alert FROM sensor_registry r JOIN climate_alerts a ON r.sensor_id = a.sensor_id GROUP BY r.model_name, r.installation_date, r.sensor_id) t GROUP BY model_name;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sensor_registry (sensor_id INT, model_name VARCHAR, installation_date DATE); CREATE TABLE climate_alerts (sensor_id INT, alert_time TIMESTAMP);
